meta.notes: A cut slab: two stack into a double slab, which drops two. Mined with a stone pickaxe or better, as copper. Cut Tin Slab: on random ticks it slowly ages into the exposed stage, msm_starter:exposed_cut_tin_slab, by copper's own chance, and a lower-stage neighbour holds it back. Honeycomb waxes it into msm_starter:waxed_cut_tin_slab.
